entities.name: Nikola Bartůšek

entities.summary: Nikola Bartůšek is a Czech politician, who was elected as a member of the European Parliament in 2024 for Přísaha. She was the head of migration and asylum management in Upper Austria during the 2015 European migrant crisis.
